neighbours.label: verbs of moving one's body or an object through space (leap, move, carry over, go)
fire: The deer leapt over the fallen log and vanished.
Without a word, the diver jumped from the cliff into the sea.
The crowd surged forward toward the stage.
Slowly the boat drifted across the bay.
The soldiers marched through the valley at dawn.
He hurled the bag over the wall and climbed after it.
The kids raced down the hill on their sleds.
The herd moved steadily toward the river.
quiet: The deer rested beside the fallen log and slept.
Without a word, the diver stared at the cliff above the sea.
The crowd stood quietly in front of the stage.
Slowly the boat rotted in the bay.
The soldiers camped in the valley at dawn.
He painted the bag near the wall and sat beside it.
The kids sat at the bottom of the hill with their sleds.
The herd grazed steadily beside the river.

notes: Card: leaped/leapt, over, moves, moving, go, going. Output direction (+ pole) promotes move/go/forward; + pole is 'back' (stepping back in time). Probe was weak (0.12-0.21) so this label may fail.
